prompts.title: Get Started with Prompt Management
prompts.description: Langfuse Prompt Management helps you centrally manage, version control, and collaboratively iterate on your prompts. Start using prompt management to improve your LLM application's performance and maintainability.
prompts.decoupledDescription: Deploy new prompts without application redeployment, making updates faster and easier
prompts.editDescription: Non-technical users can easily edit prompts in the UI. Developers can optionally update prompts programmatically via the API and SDKs
prompts.performanceDescription: Client-side caching prevents latency or availability issues for your applications
prompts.metricsDescription: Track latency, cost, and evaluation metrics across different prompt versions

scores.title: Get Started with Scores
scores.description: Scores allow you to evaluate the quality/safety of your LLM application through user feedback, model-based evaluations, or manual review. Scores can be used programmatically via the API and SDKs to track custom metrics.
scores.feedbackDescription: Gather thumbs up/down feedback from users to identify high and low quality outputs
scores.evaluationsDescription: Use LLMs to automatically evaluate your application's outputs
scores.qualityDescription: Monitor quality metrics over time to identify trends and issues
scores.customDescription: Langfuse's scores are flexible and can be used to track any metric that's associated with an LLM application

users.title: You aren't tracking users yet
users.description: Once you add a user ID to your traces, you can correlate costs, evaluations and other LLM Application metrics to better understand how they interact with your LLM applications.
users.instruction: To start tracking users, you need to add a {field} to your traces.

sessions.title: You aren't using sessions yet
sessions.description: Sessions let you group traces that belong to the same workflow, or conversation.
sessions.instruction: To start using sessions, you need to add a {field} to your traces.

datasets.title: Get Started with Datasets & Experiments
datasets.description: Datasets in Langfuse are collections of inputs (and expected outputs) for your LLM application. You can run Experiments against these datasets to test new releases before deployment to production.
datasets.improvementDescription: Create datasets from production edge cases to improve your application
datasets.testingDescription: Benchmark new releases before deploying to production
datasets.structuredDescription: Run experiments on collections of inputs and expected outputs
datasets.workflowsDescription: Build custom workflows around your datasets via the API and SDKs, e.g. for fine-tuning, few-shotting

datasetItems.title: Add items to your dataset
datasetItems.description: Datasets are collections of specific edge cases and underrepresented patterns used to evaluate your application.
datasetItems.noAccess: You don't have access to this feature, please contact your administrator
datasetItems.uploadDescription: Import dataset items from a CSV file
datasetItems.codeDescription: Use our Python/TS/JS SDKs or custom API
datasetItems.observationsDescription: Select observations in the observations table and use a batch action to add them to your dataset

annotationQueues.title: Get Started with Annotation Queues
annotationQueues.description: Annotation queues help you manage manual annotation/labeling for your LLM projects. Create queues, define annotation metrics, and track progress.
annotationQueues.manageDescription: Create and manage annotation queues to streamline your scoring workflows
annotationQueues.collaborateDescription: Invite team members to annotate and evaluate your LLM outputs
annotationQueues.metricsDescription: Monitor annotation progress and quality metrics across your team
annotationQueues.baselineDescription: Use annotation data as a baseline to evaluate your other evaluation metrics

evaluators.title: Get started with evaluations
evaluators.descriptionIntro: Use evaluators to score traces and observations automatically. Langfuse supports two evaluator types:
evaluators.judgeDescription: use an LLM to score outputs against natural-language criteria.
evaluators.codeDescription: use {language} logic for deterministic, custom scoring.
evaluators.judgeOnlyDescription: Create evaluation templates and evaluators to automatically score your traces with LLM-as-a-judge. Set up custom evaluation criteria and let AI help you measure the quality of your outputs.
evaluators.automateDescription: Use LLM-as-a-judge to automatically evaluate your traces without manual review
evaluators.qualityDescription: Create custom evaluation criteria to measure the quality of your LLM outputs
evaluators.scaleDescription: Evaluate thousands of traces automatically with customizable sampling rates
evaluators.performanceDescription: Monitor evaluation metrics over time to identify trends and improvements

reasons.numberListsUnsupported: any-of number lists are not supported
reasons.booleanGroupsUnsupported: grouped boolean values are not supported

diagnostics.nestedGroupsUnsupported: Nested groups are not supported inside grouped values
diagnostics.mixedGroupOperators: Cannot mix AND and OR inside one value group
diagnostics.expectedGroupOperator: Expected uppercase OR (any of) or AND (all of) between grouped values
diagnostics.groupCommaUnsupported: Separate grouped values with uppercase OR or AND, not commas
diagnostics.danglingOr: Dangling OR - expected an expression after it
diagnostics.missingOrLeft: OR is missing a left-hand expression
diagnostics.missingAndLeft: AND is missing a left-hand expression
diagnostics.danglingAnd: Dangling AND - expected an expression after it
diagnostics.danglingNot: Dangling NOT - expected an expression after it
diagnostics.negationFieldOnly: Negation (-) only applies to field filters, e.g. -env:dev
diagnostics.freeTextUnsupported: Free-text search is not supported by this view
diagnostics.negatedGroupsUnsupported: Negated groups are not supported - negate individual filters instead (e.g. -env:dev)
diagnostics.orUnsupported: OR is not supported yet; filters combine with AND. Use field:(a OR b) for any-of values
diagnostics.hasSingleField: has: accepts a single field - combine multiple has: filters with AND instead
diagnostics.danglingGroupOperator: Dangling {operator} - expected a grouped value after it
diagnostics.alwaysPresentMatchesNothing: "{field}" always has a value - this filter matches nothing
diagnostics.alwaysPresentMatchesEverything: "{field}" always has a value - this filter matches everything
diagnostics.incompleteFilter: Incomplete filter "{field}" - add a value (e.g. {example}) or quote "{field}" to search as text
diagnostics.queryTooLong: Query is too long ({count} chars, max {max})
diagnostics.freeTextCannotBeNegated: Free text "{value}" cannot be negated - search text is global
diagnostics.incompleteField: Incomplete field "{field}" - add a key after the dot (e.g. {example})
diagnostics.singleContains: "{field}" supports a single *value* - multiple contains terms cannot be combined with OR
diagnostics.singleNumber: "{field}" expects a single value - any-of number lists are not supported
diagnostics.datetimeComparison: "{field}" is a datetime field - use a comparison (e.g. {example})
diagnostics.hasExpectedField: has: expects a field name, got "{value}"
diagnostics.reservedNegationToken: "{token}" is not supported yet - use -field:value to exclude (e.g. -env:dev)
diagnostics.reservedFilterOperator: "{token}" between filters is not supported yet - combine values of one field with field:(A OR B), or quote "{token}" to search text
diagnostics.andGroupingArrayOnly: AND grouping (all of) only applies to array fields like traceTags - "{field}" is not an array
diagnostics.andGroupingPlainValues: AND grouping only works with plain values, not {operator}
diagnostics.hasOperatorUnsupported: has: lists fields that have a value - it does not support {operator}
diagnostics.metadataComparisonUnsupported: Metadata filters match text - {operator} comparisons are not supported
diagnostics.scoreOperatorUnsupported: Score filters compare numbers ({numericExample}) or match categories ({categoryExample}) - {operator} is not supported
diagnostics.labeledOptionsExactOnly: "{field}" maps labeled options to exact stored values and does not support {operator}
diagnostics.fieldTypeOperatorUnsupported: "{field}" is a {type} field and does not support {operator}
diagnostics.arrayFieldOperators: "{field}" is an array field - use values ({valueExample}), any-of groups ({anyExample}), or all-of groups ({allExample})
diagnostics.negatedAllOfUnsupported: Negated all-of groups on "{field}" are not representable - negate single values instead
diagnostics.negatedOperatorUnsupported: Negation of {operator} is not representable in the Langfuse filter contract
diagnostics.negatedMetadataExactUnsupported: Negated exact match on metadata is not representable - use {example} (does not contain)
diagnostics.negatedMetadataEqualityUnsupported: Negated equality on metadata is not representable - use {example} (does not contain)
diagnostics.negatedNumberEqualityUnsupported: Negated equality is not representable - use comparisons ({lowerExample} or {upperExample})
diagnostics.singleMetadataValue: {path} supports a single value - any-of metadata groups are not supported
diagnostics.negatedNumericScoreEqualityUnsupported: Negated numeric score equality is not representable - use comparisons ({lowerExample} or {upperExample})
diagnostics.booleanScoreValue: {path} is boolean - use true or false
diagnostics.scoreComparison: {path} is {type} - comparison operators only apply to numeric scores
diagnostics.singleNumericScoreValue: {path} expects a single numeric value - any-of number lists are not supported
diagnostics.singleBooleanScoreValue: {path} expects a single boolean value - grouped boolean values are not supported
